title: Pakistan’s First Lunar Rover Named Jinnah-1

blocks.content: Jinnah-1 is Pakistan’s first-ever lunar rover and has been named by the Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO). The rover is planned for launch in 2029 aboard China’s Chang’e-8 mission and is intended for the Moon’s south polar region.

items: SUPARCO stands for Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission.
Quaid-i-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah was Pakistan’s founder and served as its first Governor-General.
Chang’e-8 belongs to China’s Chang’e lunar exploration programme.
The International Lunar Research Station is a planned multinational lunar research framework led by China.
